title: Geolocation with Real Human Gameplay Data: A Large-Scale Dataset and Human-Like Reasoning Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating 'Area Bias' (the quotient of a country's proportion in the dataset to its global share of land area) and 'Population Bias' (the quotient of a country's dataset proportion to its global share of population), and synthesizing them into a 'Geo-Pop Index' to assess the dataset's regional distribution balance.
